name: Four of Cups
meaning_for_today: Today may bring emotional apathy, dissatisfaction, or reluctance to notice new opportunities. Take time to reflect, but avoid isolating yourself from the world.
card_advice: Do not ignore opportunities because of disappointment or boredom. Look at your situation from a new perspective and appreciate what you already have.

upright.short: Apathy, contemplation, dissatisfaction, emotional withdrawal, reflection.
upright.general: The Four of Cups symbolizes emotional fatigue, dissatisfaction, and introspection. A person may feel disconnected, bored, or too focused on what is missing to notice new possibilities. The card encourages reflection and reevaluation of priorities.
upright.in_love: Emotional distance, boredom, or uncertainty in relationships. One partner may feel misunderstood or emotionally withdrawn. Honest communication is needed to restore harmony.
upright.in_situation: The situation may seem stagnant or emotionally draining. Hidden opportunities exist, but they may be overlooked because of pessimism or lack of motivation.

reversed.short: New opportunities, emotional awakening, renewed interest, acceptance.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Four of Cups indicates emotional renewal, openness to new experiences, and the ability to recognize opportunities. A person begins to move beyond apathy and regain motivation.
reversed.in_love: Renewed emotional interest, reconciliation, or willingness to improve a relationship. Openness and communication can strengthen emotional bonds.
reversed.in_situation: The situation improves through renewed awareness, fresh perspectives, and acceptance of opportunities that were previously ignored.
